detects: `doctor` prints its Claude hooks section on a codex-only session, where no Claude wiring was ever meant to exist
why: Medium difficulty, and it fails in the direction that looks GENEROUS: doctor shows more, not less. Nothing errors and no line is wrong in isolation. The agent has to know from features/doctor.md that tool-awareness is directional — a codex session must show the codex binary and must NOT show a Claude hooks section — and then drive a codex-only session to see it. This is the exact regression cmd_status.go's comments describe shipping once already: a panel that read as 'Claude capture is configured' on a session with no Claude wiring at all.
